case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Estimate Exceeds Hard Credit Budget
tests: Checks that an over-budget estimate produces a clear budget warning and no generation, rather than an unauthorized cheaper substitute.

must_haves.item: The response states that the 90-credit estimate exceeds the 30-credit budget.
must_haves.why: The agent explicitly says the 90-credit estimate exceeds the hard limit of 30 credits.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says generation has not started.
must_haves.why: The agent says it will stop without generating anything, clearly indicating no generation has begun.

must_haves.item: No clip or substitute asset is delivered.
must_haves.why: The transcript contains only a refusal to generate, with no clip or substitute asset.

reply.summary: The agent meets all three must-haves by acknowledging the budget overrun and stopping without generating or delivering anything.
